page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 224.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression is rated in the bottom 10%. However, the 56 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance in stress-ng, Geekbench, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds, and database operations like Redis SET run at an average rate of 38.16 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge utilizes a legacy Intel Xeon architecture, offering a high density of dedicated physical cores at a qualitative resource-to-cost ratio suitable for budget-conscious deployments. It is best suited for highly parallelized workloads that can leverage the 56 physical cores, such as multi-threaded software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations, while being less optimal for single-threaded tasks or applications requiring advanced vector instructions.
